link.note: Named (deceased) as Servatius's mother in the 1836 marriage (original read). Dates 1771–1829 are tree-only; death before Oct 1836 confirmed; Johann was a widower in 1844.

death.place: Munzingen, Freiburg im Breisgau, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

summary: John's 5th great-grandmother; wife of Johann Ev. Birkenmayer of Munzingen.
bio: Magdalena Erb is named as the late mother of Servatius in the 1836 Munzingen marriage. The Ancestry tree gives 1771–1829. No Erb appears in any Breisgau GEDBAS file (Magdalena Erbs there belong to Friesenheim (Ortenau), Lancaster PA and Ontario); none in Munzingen in GEDBAS.
sources: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1590 (Munzingen, Catholic parish, civil-register duplicates/Standesbücher 1810–1839; 549 images; record id 5-480946), marriages 1836 http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480946-464
openQuestions: Death c.1829 (L 10 Nr. 1590 deaths) and her origin.
